why: Anchored on Surge (+3) with a new twist: Overdue has signals for it (+2) for the first time, so the ticket leans across both sides of the board. 19 (+5: Pair cluster, Not in last game, Surge) and 10 (+4) are the Surge numbers with the best leans; 11 is the single heavy-consensus slot (6 policies, 15 builds, 12 draws in the last 20); 13 is a lightly backed Surge and Rising number. Then the hedge after three rounds of hot-family numbers underdrawing: 70 from Overdue and 4, a cold number (1 draw in the last 20) no build has.
